en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural village set in rolling hills and fields. Farmhouses and barns with pitched roofs are scattered across the landscape, leading up to a small church with a tower in the distance. The scene is peaceful and pastoral, with trees and open meadows under a partly cloudy sky. At the bottom left of the postcard, a caption reads "Schellerhau - Osterzgebirge".
